levels.surface: أبو الحسن علي بن مالك النحوي

notes: «بإسناده الأول» is a back_reference: no previous report is in the context, so it is kept as written and the names it stands for are not supplied.
«سأل رجل أبا عمرو بن العلاء» is a story inside the report: the man and Abu Amr are in the scene, not links; Isa b. Umar tells it (rule 6).
